title: Activate mux sessions and settle stream opens across parent close
body:
The owner asked that every flake encountered while restoring TinySite publishing be fixed at its source. UrlResolver's [stressTestActiveQueryReportsResponseReadFailure](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlResolver/blob/main/tests/stressTestActiveQueryReportsResponseReadFailure.kts) failed during the work on https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlResolver/pull/1246 and https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlResolver/pull/1263; the investigation isolated a session exposed before activation, where closing its parent could leave stream/controller futures unfinished.

Publish Yamux/Mplex sessions after activation, observe physical close even during handler addition, and settle queued opens before close completes. Register pending results before scheduling and recheck closed state to cover registration racing close. Observe the privately owned creation future so caller cancellation or completion of the stream view cannot suppress controller closure. Normal ping/close behavior is retained. The branch also incorporates the parent-close ownership implementation and original tests from https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/pull/39, with an additional correction that completes an already-closed operation through a physical-close listener so early observers cannot report completion before pending opens settle.

Validation:
- Original four-case real TCP/Noise reproduction fails 3/3 runs on unchanged develop: 12/12 cases time out.
- Added publication/preactivation cases fail first; installation-close cases fail 2/2; strict close-completion cases fail 2/2 on the initial correction; caller future mutation cases fail 6/6 before the private-observer correction.
- Final 20-case suite passes 10/10 isolated 128 MiB JVM runs: 200/200, zero failures/errors/skips. Tests use public Host/Connection/Session APIs, real loopback TCP/Noise and public debug visitors.
- Initial lane208 broader gate: 482/485. The independent lane220 results and remaining failures are recorded below.
- Unchanged develop previously reproduced the plaintext echo timeout. Lane220 independently tested both formerly unclassified scenarios 5 times on each head; neither reproduced in that comparison. A valid coalesced plaintext selection/identity probe reproduces root negotiation twice, Mplex timeout and Yamux initialization closure 5/5 per muxer on both implementations. No timeout, iteration, assertion or test was weakened.

[Full findings, stacks and evidence](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/evidence/lane208-mux-publication-20261015/lane208-evidence). The initial reproduction is preserved at https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/fix/lane165-mux-close-during-publication . The companion consumer change is https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlResolver/pull/1269 .

Declares snapshot-31; no artifact was published. The parent-close implementation from https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/pull/39 is now incorporated, including the new early-observer correction; that PR remains open and its overlapping source must be reconciled when landing both. FORK.md documents the Gradle/Maven-local publication procedure.

Repository Actions permissions currently say allowed_actions=local_only, so external-action workflows cannot start. Native Gradle results above are the available verification; this lane did not change settings or monitor/re-request CI.

### Review (lane 220)

Independent test and code reviews found a missing off-loop case and an early-observer close-completion gap. Added 64 concurrent public stream opens with exact 128 completion assertions (fails 2/2 with the original source removed, passes all ten fixed runs), plus four early-observer cases covering Connection.close and pipeline close for both muxers. Standalone source failed both explicit-close cases; the unmodified parent-close helper failed both pipeline cases. The final correction passes 28/28 focused cases, with 0 failures, retaining both original ownership tests. Both originally unclassified failures pass 5/5 on the branch and 5/5 on unchanged develop; neither is claimed absent. Valid selection-plus-identity coalescing fails 5/5 per muxer on both source states; controls pass 5/5. The root is a repeated activation from Negotiator teardown after the earlier activation guard is removed. Final broader verification: 489/493 passing (488 selected tests plus 5 transport checks added after correcting the filter), 4 failures. The remaining plaintext failures are twoEchosOverSecureConnection, unsupportedServerProtocol, echoOverSecureConnection and largeEchoOverSecureConnection; their individual new trials were not all separately reproduced on base, so **broader validation remains red**. The full module unit task has not produced a complete verdict within this lane’s time limit. The source review checked result removal, completion reentry, all nine parent-close helper calls, caller-owned future independence, and preservation of the parent-close work. QUIC native stream creation remains unchanged; its transport close paths now share the incorporated ownership helper. Head: https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/commit/7a27e4890885592f60ad402af6af30b5578da364. [Invariant table, test-edit audit, source patches, commands, full stacks and XML](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/evidence/lane220-classify-review-20261015/lane220-evidence). No merge, queue, publication or deployment.
